items.prompt: State your motivation and purpose for studying at ICU in 500 to 600 words. Include the following points: (1) Study and career plans (2) Your motivation to study Japanese in the Japanese Language Program and conduct specialized studies in both English and Japanese (3) Contributions you can make to realize ICU's ideals
items.ru: Personal statement на 500–600 слов: зачем ICU, планы учёбы и карьеры, мотивация учить японский и вклад в идеалы ICU.
items.evidence: Applicants are required to write a 500-600 word personal statement on their motivation and purpose for studying at ICU. State your motivation and purpose for studying at ICU in 500 to 600 words.

items.prompt: Applicants are required to write an essay on one of the topics listed below. The essay must have a title and be 400 to 500 words in length, and should include the applicant's personal point of view on the issue and/or how the issue has affected or impacted the applicant: A) Discuss a current issue of personal, local, national, or international concern and its importance to you. B) Describe a work of art (painting, literature, music, etc.), a historical episode, or a scientific achievement that has impressed you and explain how it has affected your outlook on life. C) Evaluate a significant experience, achievement, challenge, or ethical dilemma you have accomplished/faced and its impact on you.
items.ru: Short essay на 400–500 слов с заголовком: выбрать одну из трёх тем (актуальная проблема, произведение искусства или научное достижение, значимый опыт) и показать свой взгляд.

items.ru: Два письма от учителей старшей школы; хотя бы одно — от учителя школы, которую вы заканчиваете, и хотя бы одно — по основному предмету.
items.evidence: Applicants must submit two letters of recommendation from high school teachers.

items.ru: ICU School Report — обязательная форма, её заполняет и загружает школьный консультант; свою версию загрузить нельзя.
items.evidence: Applicants must request their school counselor to submit the ICU School Report.

items.ru: Активности, волонтёрство и стажировки за время старшей школы или после неё — в форме OAS, без лимита.
items.evidence: Applicants can list extracurricular activities, community service, or internships undertaken during or after high school.

items.ru: Special Recognition: награды и признания после старшей школы. Приложить можно не больше трёх официальных грамот с печатью или подписью.
items.evidence: Applicants may list honors, awards, or special recognitions obtained during or after high school. Up to three official certificates with the official seal or signature of the issuing institution may be uploaded.

items.ru: Онлайн-собеседование в Zoom — только для Type B; перед ним обязательный тест связи в отдельный день. Type A (SAT/ACT/IB/A-level) собеседования не проходит.
items.evidence: Type B applicants must complete an online interview in addition to the documentary screening. A mandatory connection test will be conducted on a separate date prior to the interview

items.ru: Официальные баллы IELTS или TOEFL, которые проходят пороги вуза.
